prompt: On a busy construction site at midday, a yellow tower crane hoists steel beams above a concrete mixer dumping fresh cement onto a rebar grid. Four construction workers in orange safety vests and hard hats operate jackhammers, welders, and power drills. Piles of red bricks and stacked wooden planks line the perimeter, while a wheelbarrow full of gravel sits next to a portable generator. Traffic cones cordon off an earth-moving excavator digging beside a dump truck loaded with sand. A blueprint lies open on a folding table next to a walkie-talkie and a spirit level. Safety goggles and ear muffs hang on a steel beam near a first-aid kit mounted on a post. There is no glass skyscraper, no plastic toy, no streetlight, no parked car, and no wooden crate.
